title: Eligibility Criteria for Subsidies for TCM Consultations and Ensuring Quality Assurance Standards for These Treatments within Healthier SG
what_it_is: Eligibility Criteria for Subsidies for TCM Consultations and Ensuring Quality Assurance Standards for These Treatments within Healthier SG

sections.label: TCM integration into healthcare
sections.summary: MOH plans to integrate selected TCM interventions into the mainstream Western-centric healthcare system, as done for acupuncture for lower back and neck pain.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: In my speech at the Public Free Clinic Society's 50th Anniversary Charity Dinner, I announced the Ministry of Health's (MOH's) plan to carefully integrate selected Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) interventions into our mainstream Western-centric healthcare system, as we have done for acupuncture for lower back and neck pain.

sections.label: Voluntary TCM accreditation system
sections.summary: MOH and the TCM Practitioners Board will launch a voluntary accreditation system for TCM service providers participating in Healthier SG.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: MOH and the TCM Practitioners Board will be launching a voluntary accreditation system to accredit TCM service providers that can participate in Healthier SG collaboratively with Healthier SG clinics.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: The accreditation will ensure good governance, adherence to established protocols and the maintenance of professional competencies for high quality and safe TCM practice.

sections.label: Reviewing TCM for integration
sections.summary: Only acupuncture for lower back and neck pain is integrated; research should be reviewed to explore further integration if safe, efficacious and cost effective.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: Today, only acupuncture for lower back and neck pain are integrated into our public health institutions.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: There has been much scientific research on TCM and we should review them and explore the possibility of further integration, provided that the interventions are proven to be safe, efficacious and cost effective.

sections.label: Accreditation under self-regulatory TCM
sections.summary: TCM is self-regulatory under the TCM Practitioners' Board, and accreditation does not mean an MC will be recognised.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: As you know, TCM is a self-regulatory system, so it comes under the TCM Practitioners' Board chaired by Dr Teo Ho Pin.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: I am afraid I have to give you an answer not different from how Minister Chee gave the answer on Bukit Panjang LRT which is, I think, as soon as possible, hopefully, next year, sometime next year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: I do have to clarify even with the accreditation system, this is an accreditation system under a self-regulatory framework.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: So, it does not follow that if you are accredited, your MC will be recognised.

sections.label: No subsidy outside mainstream
sections.summary: Outside the mainstream system there is no subsidy, no MediSave, and MCs are not recognised.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: Once you are outside of the mainstream system, there is no subsidy, there is no MediSave, your MCs are not recognised.

sections.label: Referral protocols for TCM integration
sections.summary: TCM and Western doctors must work out referral protocols for each disease, and integrated interventions like acupuncture can be subsidised.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: For every disease, we need to bring TCM and Western doctors together, work out referral protocols.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: We must make sure it is well integrated and we can implement them; and when we implement them, if they are integrated just like acupuncture for lower back and neck pain, it is and it can be subsidised.
